rationale.campaign_length: A59有72项直接任务定义，可能受条件分支限制。
rationale.colonization: 移民和愚地复苏并非海外殖民主轴。
rationale.complexity: 吸血鬼阶层影响力、领地战争及多年恢复任务交错。
rationale.dark_story: 血食、收割与不人道实验构成实质阴暗内容。
rationale.difficulty: 需要管理阶层与多线目标；未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 帝国关系和血之宫廷网络提供外交目标。
rationale.early_pressure: 贫穷边境国面对阿舍尼安德和帝国邻近压力。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 吸血鬼、血契和强力法师贯穿主线，奇械是后期支线。
rationale.narrative_density: 家族旧怨、暗夜宫廷与地域复苏连成完整故事。
rationale.tall_play: 愚地修复、首都和生产城市建设占很大篇幅。
rationale.trade_economy: 河运、畜牧、纺织及财政门槛不可忽略。
rationale.warfare: 阿舍尼安德、帝国与南方扩张是重要线路。

identity.formation_scope: 本条目是A59原Tag的专属任务；未拥抱吸血鬼且符合条件时可另行形成Z07多斯塔诺，完成假面舞会后该决议被国家标记禁止

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 蓝宝石钥匙一直是这片土地上统治者的权威徽章。蓝宝石之钥最初由卡斯坦一世赠与两位福阿瑞克酋长中的一位，使他们得以进入卡斯托纳斯城，与卡斯托纳斯城的联系使渡鸦王得以进入多斯坦堡，并在龙醒期间确保了多斯塔诺的安全。从那时起，拥有蓝宝石钥匙就成了权力的象征，从科巴尔人到大卡德斯特人，再到现代的西尔·维温国王。统治者和王朝来来去去，但这把钥匙和它所赋予的权力却经久不衰。
description.text_en: The Sapphire Key has long been the badge of authority for the rulers of this land. Originally gifted by Castan I to one of two Foaric chiefs, it enabled them to enter the city of Castonath, the association of which allowed the Raven King to enter Bal Dostan and secure Dostanor during the Dragonwake. Since then, the possession of the Sapphire Key has been a symbol of power, from the Korbarids to Great Cardest to the modern síl Vivin kings. Rulers and dynasties come and go, but the key and the power that its possession grants has endured.

description.text:
从这片土地存在的那一刻起，它就一直是严酷、灰暗和被诅咒的。

「恶毒者」达拉万在669年创造了愚地，以抵御豺狼人溺亡哈兹，淹没了旧多斯塔诺的南半部，但豺狼人的幸存者却毫无所获。卡德斯特人和科巴尔人互相进行的大屠杀、卡斯坦·乌木寒霜对这片土地的重新征服、臭名昭著的科乌里亚人尼奇默的崛起使整个大陆陷入战争，以及最后的白色瘟疫——这里的人们已经在多年的文化创伤中变得坚韧和麻木，或许，只有真正可怕的东西才能撼动科乌里亚人
description.text_en:
For as long as this land has existed, it has been harsh, grim, and cursed.

Daravan the Malignant created the Folly in 669 to fend off the gnollish Drowned Xhaz, drowning the southern half of old Dostanor to no avail for the gnollish survivors, and worse things now threaten our borders. The pogroms committed by the Cardesti and the Korbarids on each other, the Castanorian reconquest of the land by Castan Ebonfrost, the rise of the infamous Corvurian, Nichmer, plunging the continent into war, and finally the White Pestilence - the people here have been hardened and desensitized by cultural traumas over years, and as such, only truly terrifying things can shake a Corvurian..

description.text:
黑荆棘骑士团是一个骑士组织，其祖先可追溯到阿德蕾西娅圣战。正是阿德蕾西娅圣战的矛尖刺入了科乌里亚黑暗的心脏，最终割除了导致瘟疫的脓疱。因此，他们的领袖卢西安·西尔·维温被贾赫授予了保护者的称号，虽然他最终消失，但他的家族和他的骑士团却延续了下来，科乌里亚的国王们仍然将黑荆棘骑士团大团长作为他们的头衔之一。科乌里亚的大多数现代贵族要么是黑荆棘骑士团的成员，要么至少其祖先曾是黑荆棘骑士团的成员。

黑荆棘骑士团因三件事而闻名于世：他们对奈拉特坚定不移（即使是非正统的）的献身精神，他们在战争中残酷而有效的技能，以及他们对西尔·维温国王不容置疑的忠诚。每当科乌里亚受到威胁时，无论是可怕的怪物、可怕的亡灵，还是简单的顽抗农民，骑士团都会以同样的方式做出回应：「消灭，以极端的偏见。」许多村庄在黑荆棘审判之后被夷为平地，因此，农民们会迅速谴责他们的反叛同伴，以防止自己的村庄成为下一个法庭的审判地。
description.text_en:
The Order of the Black Thorns is a chivalric order that traces its ancestry back to the Aldresian Crusade. It was the spear-tip of the crusade into the dark heart of Corvuria, which eventually lanced the pustule that caused the pestilence. For this reason, their leader, Lucian síl Vivin, was granted the title of Protector by Jaher, and though he would ultimately disappear, his family and his order would live on, and the Corvurian kings still count the Grand Master of The Black Thorns amongst their titles. Most modern nobles of Corvuria are either a part of or at least had an ancestor who was part of the Order.

The Order of the Black Thorns is known openly for three things: their steadfast, if unorthodox, devotion to Nerat, their brutal and effective skills in war, and their unquestioning loyalty to the síl Vivin kings. Whenever Corvuria is threatened, whether by horrific monsters, terrible undead, or a simple recalcitrant peasant, the Order responds in the same manner: ‘Obliterate, with extreme prejudice.’ Many villages have been left burned to the ground in the wake of a Black Thorn Tribunal, and as such, peasants are quick to denounce their rebellious fellows to prevent their village from becoming the site of the next tribunal.

description.text:
这就是达然五世·西尔·维温-阿兰嫩国王对宫廷中法师批评过度使用魔法提高土地农业生产力的回应——这些法师随后都失踪了。

科乌里亚境内的国王，无论是科乌里亚人、科巴尔人还是其他人，其权力和至高无上的地位一直都非常强大。虽然许多其他王国，如洛伦特、达梅里亚和威克斯，有时需要小心翼翼地避免激怒强大的附庸，并且必须时刻意识到他们的权利，但在科乌里亚，法律是明确的：除了蓝宝石钥匙持有者赋予他们的权利之外，贵族没有任何神圣的权利，异议被视为叛国。在巫师王时代，这种态度在科乌里亚之外变得越来越普遍，即使在16世纪科乌里亚被阿兰嫩人征服后，这种态度也被他们采用并保持。
description.text_en:
- King Daran V síl Vivin-Arannen, in response to criticisms by mages within his court about the overuse of magic to boost agricultural productivity of the land. The mages in question subsequently vanished.

The power and primacy of kings within Corvuria, be they Corvurian, Korbarid, or otherwise, have always been extremely strong. While many other realms, such as Lorent, Dameria, and Wex, at times need to be cautious of upsetting powerful vassals and always must be cognizant of their rights, in Corvuria, the law is clear: the nobility have no enshrined rights except those granted to them by the Holder of the Sapphire Key, and dissent is treason. This temperament became more and more common outside Corvuria in the period of the Age of Witch-Kings, being adopted and maintained by the Arannese even after their subjugation of Corvuria in the 1600s.

description.text:
尽管王权在科乌里亚占统治地位，但真正的白痴君主才会不给别人提供建议的渠道，毕竟，正如塞拉多拉女王曾经说过的，「我们明天可能会死，所以我们今天要喝酒。」

假面舞会是从罗尔萨德圣战者（后来成为现代科乌里亚贵族）继承下来的传统，是国家运作的核心。在这里，所有科乌里亚人，无论贫富贵贱，无论老幼，都可以毫无顾忌地自由交际、放纵和放荡。事实上，这是平民与贵族打成一片的唯一机会。举办一场盛大的假面舞会是一种莫大的荣耀，只有少数几个能得到国王赏识的贵族才能获得这种荣耀，而那些举办假面舞会的人也能从这种美好的谈话中振奋精神，获得新的盟友或重燃旧日的情谊。当然，也有一些人指出，举办假面舞会的总是那些家族，而这也总是会让他们获得比以前更多的权力和影响力。

「指出」是一个关键的词……唉，看来今晚又将有几位失踪的客人。
description.text_en:
Despite the utter dominance of royal power within Corvuria, it is a truly idiotic monarch who would not provide an avenue for advice to be given, and after all, as Queen Celadora once said, “We may die tomorrow, so we’ll drink today.”

A tradition carried over from the Roilsardi crusaders who became the modern Corvurian nobility, the masquerade is a tradition at the heart of the functioning of the state. It is here that all Corvurians, rich and poor, old or young, can intermingle, indulge, and debase themselves freely without fear. Indeed, this is the only chance commoners have to mingle with the nobility. Hosting a grand masquerade is a great honour, solely held to the few nobles who have the king's ear, and those who host the masquerades refresh themselves from such fine conversation and gain new allies or rekindle old ones. Of course, there are some who pointed out that it's always the same families who hold these masquerades, and it always leads to them accruing more power and influence than before.

'Pointed out' being the operative word.

description.text: 人们常说，唯一比科乌里亚农奴还要贫穷的是他耕种的土地，这显然是错误的。这里的土地和劳动力都同样贫瘠，唯一能让这儿变得更富裕的办法就是把它们都榨干。尽管这里的土壤是火山灰土性质的，然历史上强横君权的横征暴敛、豺狼人从愚地发起的频繁袭击以及白色瘟疫余毒未清……等等因素灾患交迫，迫使这里的黎黎下民不得不成为相当有效率的农民和劳工。盖非如此韧毅，则无以至今日。
description.text_en: Land and laborers are equally poor here, and the only way we can get any richer is to work them both to the bone. Despite the soil being volcanic in nature, the interplay of such strong historic royal prerogatives, the frequent threat of raids from the Folly by gnolls, and holdovers from the effect of the White Pestilence have forced the population to become rather effective farmers and laborers out of necessity. For if they were not so, they would not be so.

description.text:
「……例如，投资伐木业、采矿业以及卡恩沃德河和多斯塔内斯克河沿岸的基础设施。有了科乌里亚土地提供的充足资源，再加上农民们的辛勤采掘，并将其运送到阿兰嫩的工厂，我相信我们的王国一定能巩固自己作为工业强国的领先地位。如果能在科乌里亚境内建造工厂，工业成本会更低，但由于淳朴的劳动力识字率相对较低，以及……更深奥的问题，这在政治上暂时还不现实……」

——魔法师瓦罗森的奥斯坦，在他写给奥斯坦四世·西尔·维温-阿兰嫩的《科乌里亚土地概览》一文中写道，1801年
description.text_en:
…For example, investment in logging, mining, and riverine infrastructure along the Carnvord and Dostanesck rivers. With ample resources provided by our Corvurian lands, ably extracted by peasants, and transported to factories in Arannen, I am confident that our realm will be able to cement itself as a leading industrial power. Industrial costs would be lower if it were possible to build factories within Corvuria itself, but the comparative lack of literacy amongst the simpleton workforce as well as… more esoteric concerns render that politically impractical for the time being..."

- Magister Ostan of Varlosen, in his essay 'A Survey of our Corvurian Lands', to Ostan IV síl Vivin-Arannen, 1801

player_overview.avoid_if: 不喜欢阶层门槛、强邻压力或以臣民为血食的阴暗叙事的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先以外交、军队和经济稳住边境，再调整阶层力量推动假面舞会，同时积累领土、法力与财政完成愚地复苏。
player_overview.overview: 科乌里亚开局由席尔·维文王室统治，吸血鬼贵族已深植于国家。你先要守住边境、清算阿舍尼安德，再通过假面舞会和血之宫廷把暗夜势力制度化；另一边还得修复荒废的愚地、经营河道与城市。它是一场哥特宫廷政治与长期重建并行的战役。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢哥特吸血鬼、宫廷权术、法师统治者和长线重建的玩家。
signature_features: 吸血鬼阶层、午夜君主制与有条件的吸血鬼强力法师统治者。
与阿舍尼安德的家族旧怨、帝国政治和黑暗军团。
达拉文愚地的分阶段修复，不只是征服地图。
player_overview.tagline: 边境穷国与吸血鬼贵族结盟，建起午夜王庭，并让被诅咒的愚地重新繁荣。

reasons: 吸血鬼政治有鲜明的身份和机制
愚地修复给征服之外的长期目标
王朝宿怨与帝国外交形成完整剧情
warnings: 假面舞会及永生领主都有条件门槛
完成吸血鬼主线会失去形成多斯塔诺的资格

positive_indicators: 分阶段治愈愚地并迁回人口
边境堡垒可保护部分居民
values.rationale: 首都任务叙事将普通居民视作吸血鬼血食，完成阿舍尼安德相关任务会触发使阿什菲尔德发展受损并严重荒废的收割事件，晚期还容许不人道实验；愚地修复、河道与城市建设带来真实公共收益。扣分基于具体伤害，而非吸血鬼身份、战争或君主制。
red_flags: 以居民作为夜之贵族血食的叙事与国家默许
阿什菲尔德收割事件造成当地严重荒废与发展损失
任务文本支持不人道的奇械实验
